args.reason: The PRDR cites two goals but serves only one. 'Export transactions as CSV' is served by the one-row-per-transaction item. 'Filter transaction exports by date' is cited, yet the second DoD item states that no date input or date filtering is implemented. The Phase-1 reason claims export serves both cited goals, which the DoD itself contradicts. A cited goal left unserved is the unserved ground. The PRDR would pass if it either dropped the date-filter citation or added a date-filter DoD item.
